summary.text: Adrienne Jones is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 10 in Baltimore County, first elected in 1998 after being appointed in 1997. Her official page lists her as Speaker of the House from 2019 to 2025 and, in 2026, a member of the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Adrienne A. Jones's official page says she was born in Cowdensville, Maryland, in 1954 and graduated from Lansdowne Senior High School in 1972.
It lists a B.A. in psychology from the University of Maryland Baltimore County in 1976 and an honorary Doctor of Law degree from Goucher College in 2008.

It says she was employed by Baltimore County government from 1976, including as Director of the Office of Minority Affairs from 1989 to 1995 and Executive Director of the Office of Fair Practices and Community Affairs from 1995 to 2011.
The page says she was appointed to the House of Delegates on October 15, 1997, and sworn in on October 21, 1997.
It lists her as Speaker Pro Tem from 2003 to 2019 and Speaker of the House from 2019 to 2025.
She is also listed as a member of the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland and Women Legislators of Maryland, and the page lists two sons and two grandchildren.
